title: How an implant is usually done
lead: Usually this takes several visits, with time between them for the area to heal.

steps.label: The gap
steps.words: The tooth is gone and the area has healed. The bone is checked to see if an implant can go here.

steps.label: Place the implant
steps.words: A small titanium post is placed in the bone with the area numbed.

steps.label: Let it heal
steps.words: The bone grows around the post. You can usually go about your day.

steps.label: Add the connector
steps.words: A small connector is fixed to the post. The gum settles around it.

steps.label: Fit the crown
steps.words: The new tooth (a crown) is fitted on the connector.
